item.title: Rubio’s remarks on ancient Iran and Greece raise concerns over political use of history: Diplomat

item.title: In photos: Universities open for new academic year in Iran
item.description: The opening ceremony for universities for the new academic year took place at Shahid Beheshti University in Tehran on October 12, 2026, attended by President Masoud Pezeshkian, Science Minister Hossein Simaei Sarraf, Health Minister Mohammad-Reza Zafarghandi, university presidents, and students.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/photo/86290361/In-photos-Universities-open-for-new-academic-year-in-Iran

The opening ceremony for universities for the new academic year took place at Shahid Beheshti University in Tehran on October 12, 2026, attended by President Masoud Pezeshkian, Science Minister Hossein Simaei Sarraf, Health Minister Mohammad-Reza Zafarghandi, university presidents, and students.
